items.headline: Transamerica Expands AI Partnership with Amazon Web Services
items.summary: Transamerica has deepened its collaboration with Amazon Web Services to scale artificial intelligence across its enterprise operations.

items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. reported an acquisition or disposal of voting rights in ICG PLC, a UK-based issuer, with the threshold crossed on November 13, 2026.

items.headline: NVIDIA Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
items.summary: NVIDIA announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2027, reporting revenue of $115.8 billion, a 103% increase year-over-year.

items.headline: Generation Life Launches ConfidencePlus Annuity with BlackRock Alliance
items.summary: Generation Life has introduced an investment-linked lifetime annuity product, ConfidencePlus, developed in partnership with BlackRock.

items.headline: Broadcom to Invest $1 Billion in Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Broadcom has agreed to invest $1 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering as part of a strategic commitment involving major technology suppliers.

items.headline: Microsoft Launches AI Transparency Initiative
items.summary: Microsoft has introduced an AI Transparency Initiative aimed at establishing common standards for security, governance, and transparency in artificial intelligence models.

items.summary: Rockwell Automation has introduced new industrial computing solutions powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing to enhance edge AI capabilities.

items.summary: Amazon has added ready-to-eat and heat-and-eat meal options to its same-day grocery delivery and Amazon Now services.

items.headline: BlackRock Designated as Critical Third Party for UK Financial Sector
items.summary: The UK government has designated BlackRock as a critical third party for the financial sector, subjecting the firm to increased regulatory oversight.

items.headline: Microsoft Commences Ignite 2026 Conference
items.summary: Microsoft has launched its annual Ignite conference in San Francisco, utilizing Haivision's video ecosystem to support global live event production.

items.headline: Mizuho Initiates BlackRock at Outperform With $1,450 Price Target
items.summary: Mizuho has initiated coverage of BlackRock, Inc. with an 'Outperform' rating and a price target of $1,450.

items.headline: NVIDIA Issues Warning to Chip Buyers Regarding US Export Compliance
items.summary: NVIDIA has cautioned customers about potential US legal risks associated with providing remote access to advanced chips for Chinese firms.

items.headline: Microsoft Expands Use of Haivision Live Video Ecosystem
items.summary: Microsoft has selected Haivision's video transport and control solutions to support the production of over 600 global events annually.

items.headline: BlackRock Participates in Bajaj Finance Private Share Offering
items.summary: BlackRock, alongside other institutional investors, participated in a $1.2 billion private share offering by Bajaj Finance.

items.headline: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A. Reports Q3 Earnings and Revenue Growth
items.summary: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A. (SQM) announced an increase in both earnings and revenue for the third quarter of 2026.

items.headline: Corporación América Airports Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Corporación América Airports S.A. released its unaudited, consolidated financial results for the three and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026.

items.headline: dLocal Joins Visa's Agentic Ready Program
items.summary: dLocal is collaborating with Visa to explore and enable secure agentic commerce across local payment ecosystems in emerging markets.

items.headline: Novartis Showcases Hematology and Breast Cancer Leadership at ASH and SABCS
items.summary: Novartis announced it is highlighting its hematology portfolio and breast cancer treatment leadership at upcoming medical conferences, including the American Society of Hematology (ASH) and the San An

items.headline: Macquarie Analysts Adjust SoftBank Group Target Price Amid Net Asset Value Decline
items.summary: Macquarie analysts lowered their target price for SoftBank Group Corp. to 7,600 yen from 8,850 yen, citing a decline in pro forma net asset value due to stock-price weakness at Arm Holdings.

items.headline: Barclays Maintains Overweight Rating on Prudential
items.summary: Barclays has identified Prudential as a preferred stock in its latest insurance sector analysis, assigning it an overweight rating.

items.headline: Volvo Buses Receives Bus Orders from Peru
items.summary: Volvo Buses has secured new bus orders in Peru, according to a report published on November 18, 2026.

items.headline: LONGi Participates in COP31 Side Event on Solar-Storage Integration
items.summary: LONGi Green Energy Technology Co., Ltd. participated in a COP31 side event focused on advancing energy access in less developed countries through solar-storage integration.

items.headline: Internal Review Reveals Monitoring Gaps at Deutsche Bank's Colombian Unit
items.summary: An internal review at Deutsche Bank has identified gaps in transaction monitoring processes within its Colombian operations.

items.headline: NTT Develops New AI-Powered Cyber Defense Technology
items.summary: NTT, Inc. has announced the development of a new cyber defense technology that integrates proprietary systems with multiple AI models to enhance vulnerability assessments.

items.headline: Hafnia Limited Announces Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026 and Special Dividend Plan
items.summary: Hafnia Limited reported its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, and announced an intention to distribute its TORM plc shares as a special interim dividend.

items.headline: XPeng Outlines 2027 International Expansion Strategy
items.summary: XPeng executives announced plans to more than double overseas sales by 2027, with Europe expected to account for at least half of the volume.

items.headline: Berenberg Bank Issues Buy Rating for Zurich Insurance
items.summary: Berenberg Bank has initiated or updated its coverage on Zurich Insurance, assigning the stock a 'Buy' rating.

items.headline: Intesa Sanpaolo Launches Agrifood Initiative at Pontifical Gardens
items.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has organized an agrifood event at the Pontifical Gardens in Castel Gandolfo, bringing together 80 industry players and signing a training agreement with the local community.

items.headline: NIO Energy Partners with Poly Property for Battery Swapping Station Deployment
items.summary: NIO Energy has entered a partnership with Poly Property to install battery swapping stations within residential communities and office buildings.

items.headline: Hesai Group Announces US$100 Million Share Repurchase Program
items.summary: Hesai Group has authorized a share repurchase program to buy back up to US$100 million of its Class B ordinary shares and American depositary shares over the next 12 months.

items.headline: Severn Trent Reports Half-Year Pretax Profit of £312 Million and Reaffirms FY28 Guidance
items.summary: Severn Trent announced its half-year financial results, reporting a pretax profit of £312 million while maintaining its adjusted earnings per share outlook for fiscal year 2028.

items.headline: Cirata and Tesco Stores Enter Expanded Agreement
items.summary: Cirata and Tesco Stores have entered into an expanded commercial agreement.

items.headline: Pony.ai Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Pony.ai announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting revenue of $44.6 million and an adjusted loss of $0.11 per share.

items.headline: Anglo American to Develop Large-Scale Projects Utilizing Mining By-Products
items.summary: Anglo American has announced plans to construct large-scale projects focused on the utilization of mining by-products.

items.headline: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC Announces Share Repurchase
items.summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC reported the purchase of 35,723 of its ordinary shares on November 17, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program.

items.headline: Kerry Group and World Food Programme Announce New Food Safety Initiative
items.summary: Kerry Group and the World Food Programme (WFP) have launched a three-year collaborative initiative to improve food safety and reduce waste within the WFP's distribution network.

items.headline: HashKey On-Chain Partners with Olea to Tokenize Trade Receivables
items.summary: HashKey On-Chain has partnered with trade finance platform Olea to tokenize real-world trade receivables using the HashKey Issuance Platform.

items.headline: HSK Chain Collaborates with Base to Connect Asian Assets with Global Liquidity
items.summary: HashKey Group's HSK Chain has announced a strategic collaboration with Coinbase's Base blockchain to integrate their ecosystems and enhance liquidity for Asian on-chain assets.

items.headline: JinkoSolar Collaborates on New EPIC Solar Mounting and Module Platform
items.summary: JinkoSolar is collaborating with Enstall and other industry partners to launch EPIC, a new solar module and mounting platform designed to improve installation safety and efficiency.
